title: What Makes Harbour Island’s Pink Sand So Rare?

scenes.text: 2‑kilometer stretch of pink sand in the Caribbean
scenes.query: Harbour Island pink sand beach aerial

scenes.label: FORAMINIFERAN SHELLS
scenes.text: Tiny foraminifera shells mix with white quartz, giving the sand its rosy hue.
scenes.query: Harbour Island foraminifera pink sand close up

scenes.label: CALM ATLANTIC WATERS
scenes.text: Gentle tides prevent erosion, keeping the pink color intact year‑round.

scenes.label: RARE GEOLOGICAL EVENT
scenes.text: A historic storm deposited the pink‑tinged coral fragments that never washed away.

description: Harbour Island’s pink sand isn’t just a marketing trick—it’s a natural masterpiece formed by microscopic shells and calm seas. Discover the science behind the blush.
